quests.title: The Economist's Notebook
quests.summary: An economist in Kirkgate Market has a puzzle about two stalls, and a pub regular to send you to.

steps.text: Solve Dr Akhtar's puzzle about two market stalls in Kirkgate Market.
Ask Derek at Whitelock's what a pint has to do with inflation.
Tell Dr Akhtar what Derek said.

quests.reward: Two cream teas and an Economist's notebook that fills as you play.
